articles.title: Man who was lured to remote villa and held for 15 hours rescued after being tied up and beaten
articles.summary: A man has been rescued after he was lured to an isolated villa, held for 15 hours, tied to a chair, beaten, and threatened with death, police in Spain say.

articles.title: Meet the Ukrainian energy workers dodging drones to bring people's electricity back
articles.summary: "The first thing the guys and I do is look at where we can hide."

articles.title: At least 24 dead after boat taking passengers to funeral capsizes in Nigeria
articles.summary: At least 24 people have died after a boat capsized carrying people to a funeral in Nigeria, according to emergency services.

articles.title: At least 11 dead after suspected cartel leader 'El Chapo Isidro' captured in Mexico
articles.summary: An outburst of violence has killed at least 11 people after Mexican authorities captured suspected cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro.

articles.title: Denmark says it thwarted 'Russian plot' to kill US-Ukrainian rapper
articles.summary: Police thwarted a Russian plot to kill a US-Ukrainian rapper who was performing in Denmark, according to authorities.

articles.title: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
articles.summary: Shares in Anthropic have fallen by more than 10% at Friday's open on Wall Street, just a day after their record-breaking Nasdaq debut, as part of a global stock market rout.
